title: Stable color maps
text: Subsets select names object; never rerun positional palette assignment. Factor reordering also leaves contract intact.
code: labels_full <- c("B", "T", "NK", "Mono") map <- sc_color_map(labels_full, palette = "chromatic") as_named_colors(map) ##         B      Mono        NK         T  ## "#475D8F" "#E3B54E" "#00DADF" "#765A11" labels_subset <- c("T", "NK") subset_colors <- as_named_colors(map)[labels_subset] stopifnot(identical(   subset_colors,   as_named_colors(map)[c("T", "NK")] )) reordered <- factor(labels_full, levels = rev(labels_full)) as_named_colors(map)[levels(reordered)] ##      Mono        NK         T         B  ## "#E3B54E" "#00DADF" "#765A11" "#475D8F"

title: Stable color maps
code: updated <- update_sc_color_map(map, c(labels_full, "DC")) stopifnot(identical(   as_named_colors(updated)[names(as_named_colors(map))],   as_named_colors(map) ))

title: scChromatic 0.1.0
text: Initial release persistent color maps, hierarchy-aware mappings, qualitative continuous scales, deterministic palette extension, accessibility diagnostics, provenance metadata. Includes palettes frozen ArchR commit 6feec354ad6c8052ddbc4626a2ca2d858ed465bf. Adds sc_example, deterministic synthetic PBMC-like dataset demonstrating identity, lineage, sample, condition, expression, signed-score, pseudotime, QC color semantics. Reframes ArchR-derived palettes explicitly named compatibility collection, removes unresolved ArchR provenance entries, prioritizes framework-neutral palettes throughout API documentation website. Removes ArchR-specific pal_archr() helper unprefixed palette aliases; retained compatibility colors remain available explicit archr_* IDs. Adds chromatic_balance, package-owned diverging HCL palette signed scores centered zero.
